en: Black-and-white photograph of a broad, quiet residential street lined with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century bourgeois townhouses and villas. The buildings have stucco facades, decorative cornices, and balconies with wrought‑iron railings. Trees and metal fences run along both sides of the street. A few pedestrians, including children, stand or walk along the unpaved road. In the distant background, gentle hills and a church spire or tall roof can be seen. The image has irregular black borders at the top, suggesting it is a reproduction of an old negative used as a postcard image.
